question.zh: 恒生指数在 2026-10-24 或之后首个交易日收盘，会高于 2026-10-17 吗？
question.en: Will Hang Seng close higher on the first trading day on or after 2026-10-24 than on 2026-10-17?

rationale.zh: 近 20 个交易日波动 0.92%/日，平均涨跌 -0.06%/日（按一半计入），周期约 5 个交易日（一周）。
rationale.en: 20-day volatility 0.92%/day; average move -0.06%/day, counted at half weight; about 5 trading days (one week).
